research_notes: SOURCES: all figures from Bank Mandiri IR documents (bankmandiri.co.id/web/ir: annual reports, audited FS, interim FS, analyst/corporate presentations) plus KSEI official corporate-action notices for dividend/split schedules. idx.co.id returned Cloudflare 403 and was not used; old ksei.co.id/Announcement paths 404 but the same files are served from web.ksei.co.id. No news source is used for any stored value.

BSI MERGER RESTATEMENT (Feb 2021): BRIS and BNIS were merged into BSM (now BSI) under common control; FS2021 restated FY2020 (and the 31 Dec 2019 balance sheet). fy.2019 and fy.2020 use these RESTATED figures so the series is comparable with 2021+. Originally reported: FY2020 PATMI 17,119,253 / EPS 367.04 / total assets 1,429,334,484 / total equity 193,796,083; FY2019 total assets 1,318,246,335 / total equity 209,034,525 (Rp million, FS2020).

FY2020 PAYOUT CHECK: the 60% payout (dividend Rp10,271.55bn) was applied to the ORIGINAL FY2020 PATMI Rp17,119.25bn. Against the stored restated PATMI 16,799.5bn, 60% gives 10,079.7bn (-1.9% vs dividend). Numbers left as sourced.

FY2019 DEPOSITS = null: no restated (post-merger) consolidated TPF total for Dec-2019 is printed anywhere I found; the FY2020 deck's Dec-19 TPF (933,125bn) is on the pre-merger basis and would overstate FY2020 deposit growth (~23% vs ~13% like-for-like). Deposit growth for 2020 will therefore show n/a.

LOANS DEFINITION (FY): loans_gross = FS line 'Loans and sharia receivables/financing' before allowance (filing; printed for every year incl. restated 2019). The analyst decks' consolidated 'Loans' additionally include consumer-financing and finance-lease receivables of multifinance subsidiaries (e.g. Dec-25: deck 1,894,985bn vs FS line 1,849,968bn; Dec-21: 1,050,157 vs 1,026,225). The INTERIM loans use the deck definition (see interim note) - do not compute FY->interim loan growth.

DEPOSITS DEFINITION: deposits = consolidated Third Party Funds from the analyst decks (= conventional 'deposits from customers' + BSI's mudharabah 'temporary syirkah funds - deposits from customers'). WARNING: AR2025 MD&A calls Rp1,816.90tn 'Total TPF' for Dec-2025, but that is only the conventional line (excludes ~Rp288.9tn syirkah deposits); not used.

RATIOS: roe/roa/nim/coc/npl_gross/lar/npl_coverage/ldr/car/cir/casa are CONSOLIDATED as reported in the analyst decks, each year taken from the latest deck that shows it (FY2022-25: FY2025 deck p.22; FY2021: FY2024 deck p.26; FY2020: FY2023 deck p.29). Decks restate history: e.g. FY21 LDR 78.4 (FY23 deck) vs 79.0 (FY24 deck); FY22 LDR 78.0 vs 78.3; FY22 Tier-1 18.0 vs 18.6. The FY2020/FY2021 decks used different definitions (Adj. RoAE on a 2-point average: FY20 9.16% original / 8.12% restated; CIR FY20 47.4%/48.07%, FY21 47.31%) - not used. LAR = incl. Covid-restructured loans throughout (FY20-21 'BAU' LAR excl. Covid restructuring was ~10%). ldr is the deck's 'LDR - Bank Entity' (excl. multifinance loans and loans to banks); car is the consolidated CAR (AR bank-only CAR differs, e.g. FY25 19.36% vs 20.4%).

BANK-ONLY fields: npl_net and bopo are bank-only regulatory ratios from the AR 'Financial Ratios (Bank Only)' tables (AR2025 for 2021-25, AR2024 for 2020); basis set to bank_only. The AR bank-only ROE/ROA/NIM/coverage/CIR (e.g. FY25 ROE 23.15%, NIM 4.59%) differ materially from the consolidated deck figures stored here.

EPS / SHARE BASIS around the 1:2 split (regular-market ex-date 2023-04-04): FY2020 and FY2021 EPS taken from FS2021 (authorised 2022-01-27, pre-split) -> share_basis 2022-01-27. FY2022-FY2025 EPS from AR2025 (published 2026-04-29), which restates FY2022 to the post-split basis (441.26 vs 882.52 originally) -> share_basis 2026-04-29. CAUTION: AR2025's 5-year table itself mixes bases (prints FY2021 EPS 601.06 unadjusted next to post-split 2022+), and AR2024 misprints FY2021 EPS as '60.06'. Share counts and year-end prices carry share_basis = their own year-end date (pre-split for 2020-2022). Dividends carry share_basis = announcement date; FY2020-FY2022 DPS are per pre-split share (FY2022 final was recorded 28 Mar 2023, before the split, though paid 12 Apr 2023).

SHARES OUTSTANDING: taken from the FS Note 40a shareholder tables, which print a subtotal excluding treasury shares (Dec-20/Dec-21: 46,631,266,666 = 46,666,666,666 issued less 35,400,000 treasury; Dec-25: 93,249,083,332 = 93,333,333,332 less 84,250,000 treasury). The AR share-information table labels the ISSUED count 'Total Shares Outstanding' - do not use it as net.

DIVIDENDS: DPS and cum/ex/recording/payment dates from KSEI notices (exact DPS to many decimals); AR dividend tables round DPS (220, 360.64, 529.34, 353.96, 466.18) and are the source of the totals. FY2025 had Bank Mandiri's first interim dividend (Rp100, paid 14 Jan 2026) plus a final of Rp376.956938949 (paid 25 May 2026): total Rp476.96/share, Rp44,472.22bn, 79% payout. A FY2026 interim of Rp66/share (Rp6,160bn) was paid 2 Oct 2026. No special dividends 2020-2026.

INTERIM 9M2026 / BSI DECONSOLIDATION: Bank Mandiri lost control of BSI on 27 Jan 2026 (BP BUMN revoked the special power of attorney that let the Bank exercise the Series A Dwiwarna rights in BSI and granted those rights to PT Danantara Asset Management) and deconsolidated BSI from 1 Feb 2026, keeping 51.47% with significant influence (FS 9M26 PDF p.42, Note 1g). Net assets derecognised Rp49,419,851m and NCI Rp23,844,295m. Interim balance-sheet levels (FS) and deck figures therefore EXCLUDE BSI, while every fy.* figure 2019-2025 INCLUDES it. PATMI is barely affected (FS 9M25 comparative 37,730.1bn equals the deck's pro-forma). Interim loans/deposits/ratios use the 3Q26 deck's 'Consolidated excl. BSI' columns with company pro-forma Sep-25 comparatives. Do not compare interim levels with fy.2025 levels (e.g. assets 2,588.3tn vs 2,829.9tn) as growth.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2020-2026: only the 1:2 stock split (KSEI: new-nominal trading in regular & negotiated market from 4 Apr 2023; recording 5 Apr; distribution/cash market 6 Apr). Bank Mandiri's own AR2023 describes the split as effective/listed on 6 Apr 2023 - that is the distribution date, not the ex-date. No rights issue since Feb 2011 (3Q26 deck p.70 corporate-action timeline; AR2023 share-listing chronology).
